editor.title: How letters land on the page.
editor.sub: Editor typography and writing behavior — independent of export.
editor.preview_p1: Silence spread between them like tidewater over stone. At last she spoke, her voice almost carried away by the wind, landing somewhere he could barely hear.
editor.preview_p2: “Will you come back?” He did not answer at once. He watched the sun sink into the sea, then nodded after a long while, though even he could not tell whether it was a promise or mercy.
editor.preview_p3: The wind came over the breakwater with salt and damp in it. She pulled her coat tighter, asked nothing more, and kept the question inside her instead.
editor.preview_p4: Far away, the lighthouse blinked on and off, as if counting things no one could say aloud. The waves folded every spoken and unspoken word into their noise.
editor.preview_p5: Years later, he still remembered that evening and the goodbye he never managed to say. Whenever sea wind crossed the window again, that silence returned as clearly as if it had never left. (This paragraph demonstrates Tab indent.)
editor.preview_p6: Afterward they walked into different lives. City lights dimmed the memory, then lit it again. But the sea, the sunset, and that hour kept returning on time.

privacy.title: Where your manuscript stops.
privacy.sub: A plain view of what Drifting uses, what it does not use, and when data leaves your machine.
privacy.crashLogsDesc: Send sanitized error locations, version and platform to the maintainer to diagnose failures. No manuscript text is included. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.diagnosticsDesc: Copy version, platform, feature availability, sync counts/error categories, and update state. It contains no manuscript, credential, project identifier, or absolute path and is never uploaded automatically.
privacy.diagnosticsCopyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Clipboard permission may be unavailable.
privacy.noteHosted: Your work is saved on this device first and reaches the Drifting server only when you connect hosted sync (projects and original assets) or create a share link (the shared part). With hosted sync connected, preferences such as appearance, typography and shortcuts also follow your account. Feedback you send and, when turned on below, crash diagnostics also go to the maintainer; diagnostics contain no manuscript text. AI and voice-transcription requests go straight from this device to the provider you chose, never through Drifting, under that provider's data and training terms; remote MCP extensions you add also use the network.
privacy.noteLocal: This build never contacts a Drifting server; your work stays on this device. AI and voice-transcription requests go straight from this device to the provider you chose, under that provider's data and training terms; remote MCP extensions you add also use the network.
